title: Your 2027 Part D Plan
notes:
Source account: DRS <drs@drs-engineering.net>
Task area: DRS
From: Fair Square Medicare <accounts@fairsquaremedicare.com>
Date: 2026-09-15 08:54
Subject: Your 2027 Part D Plan
Gmail message ID: 1a0a5c6f22ac45a2
Thread ID: 1a0a5c6f22ac45a2

Email body:
​​Hi David,

The Annual Enrollment Period, which runs from October 15th through December 7th each year, is the time when you can review your Part D prescription drug plan. 

You do not need to touch your Medicare Supplement. This only concerns your prescription drug plan.

We used to be able to help you reshop your prescription drug coverage, but funding for Part D programs has been cut and data for these programs is no longer being shared with brokerages like Fair Square. 

You can still find every Part D plan in your area on Medicare.gov. 2027 plans will be visible on October 1st, and you can enroll as soon as October 15th. 

Keep an eye out for a piece of mail from your carrier called an “Annual Notice of Change” (ANOC). It’ll highlight any changes to your plan in 2027. 

Remember, your Medigap plan does not change. Its benefits remain the same and it stays with you as long as you pay the premium.

Best,
